scope: Primary three arms, open cases, capacity and parity probes, separately authorized four factorial cells, and the two emitted S10 files authorized for repair readback. No prior roles, unrelated repository materials, source dispatch or production consumers inspected.
acceptance_reason: All selected actions and saved primary/factorial scores pass independent review. Both initial auxiliary flags were repaired by the parent and independently rechecked. Acceptance is limited to the recorded synthetic decisions, model arithmetic, injected-drift results and literal emitted-file checks.

case_reviews.assessment: Approval capacity rises from 4 to 8; summaries already exceed demand. All approvals retain owners. Backlog growth is reduced, not eliminated.
Summary service capacity rises from 3 to 9 with 10 approval slots; it can handle 8 new arrivals. The reported 8 completions assumes no additional starting backlog.
Recipient and accepted example resolve the stipulated missing acceptance information; architecture review cannot supply it.
The exact static-label edit meets scope at cost 1, versus cost 6 for investigation followed by the same edit.
Separate stage waits discriminate the two stipulated alternatives. They are not proof of a unique cause in a richer system.
Qualified accountable routing preserves all ten approval obligations; no exemptions or relabeling satisfy the rule.
The available local sum produces the aggregate without moving source rows. Encrypting before upload does not preserve the location rule.
Preserve five observed toy requests, withhold the 5000-request claim, and identify the missing load and type-coverage test.
The authorized direct repair restores the known missing connection and includes verification; predictive analysis does not perform the repair.
Equal coverage and evidence make total stipulated costs decisive: reuse 8, manual 10, custom 32.
Owner must reach the machine consumer; the incomplete validator cannot establish complete requirement representation.
Classical entailment supports not-Q implies not-P. P=false,Q=true refutes both inverse and converse; no unconditional truth value follows.

classical_entailment.premise: P implies Q = not P or Q
classical_entailment.finding: Inverse and converse correctly have identical truth conditions; the contrapositive correctly matches the premise. No evaluator repair is required.

primary_comparison.cost_limit: Sum of stipulated selected-action costs only; not process execution cost. Benefits use mixed case units and should not be summed.

families.authority_and_parallel_approval: Grant bounded decision rights to qualified additional owners and route work to them.
families.decision_input_quality: Improve evidence completeness/readiness to reduce reconstruction or rework at approval.
families.protected_owner_time: Recover effective service time through protected sessions and reduced interruptions/setup.

families.direct_acceptance_exit: Execute and verify an exact bounded correction when acceptance and scope suffice.
families.evidence_conditioned_selection: Use diagnostic observations and unresolved hypotheses to select, stop, or expand an investigation.
families.exhaustive_research_coverage: Run all sixteen when complete comparison is explicitly the requested deliverable and retain its per-method evidence/synthesis.

O02.assessment: Capability candidate 1 and 2 overlap as selection and diagnosis components; do not count them as two wholly independent intervention families. Its embedded direct exit nevertheless gives it the same three-family coverage as the other arms.

creativity_assessment: All arms make substantive alternatives to the incumbent, but no arm adds a mechanism family absent from the others. Typed inversion labels organize reasoning; extra labels or JSON fields do not establish more creative outcomes. The inversion arm specifies a smaller O01 feasibility probe; outcome_first specifies an explicit O02 route comparison. Those are proposed design differences, not observed benefits.

factorial_comparison.allowed_claim: In these four authored cases, supplied discriminating observations enabled three target-specific choices in each process condition; every cell handled its supplied uncertainty appropriately. No structural-process action advantage was observed.
factorial_comparison.word_difference_claim_limit: Observed JSON word counts only, not a reliable efficiency effect.

semantic_check.claim_ceiling: Required-field presence and literal canonical rendering for this saved pair only. No general paraphrase-equivalence, complete semantic-schema validation, or production-consumer claim.

findings.title: Capacity count includes baselines
findings.finding: The value 36 counts four evaluated conditions at each of nine grid points, including the unchanged baseline. There are nine baselines and 27 nonbaseline intervention conditions. All arithmetic and the 5/3/1 marginal-advantage counts are correct.
findings.required_repair: Rename the value to evaluated_condition_count=36, or report baseline_count=9 and intervention_count=27. Preserve the model-only interpretation.
findings.resolution: The revised script/report explicitly return evaluated_conditions=36, baseline_conditions=9, nonbaseline_interventions=27. Independently recomputed all nine rows again; arithmetic unchanged and correct.

findings.title: Full final parity is not established by an in-memory equality probe
findings.finding: The matching machine dictionary is a deepcopy of the human dictionary. Comparisons occur before output serialization, and the emitted Markdown/JSON are never read back. Equality via get also returns no mismatch when both records omit a required field. This correctly demonstrates two omitted checklist fields but does not validate semantic preservation or completeness of the final pair.
findings.reproduction: For required=[evidence], compare({}, {}, required) returns []; neither record supplies evidence. The code writes both final files only after constructing trials.
findings.required_repair: Narrow the result to equality of the constructed in-memory records and detection of the two injected drifts. If claiming full emitted-pair parity, separately require every obligation on both sides, validate value types and nonempty values as appropriate, read the emitted pair back, and check the human-to-machine mapping. Add shared-omission and serialization-loss negative controls.
findings.effect_on_selected_actions: None; the demonstrated checklist omission remains supported.
findings.resolution: The revised comparator explicitly rejects absent keys. Independently extracted and exercised it: shared missing evidence returns [evidence]. Read the emitted Markdown and JSON directly, confirmed all six fields exist, reconstructed canonical literal values and found no mismatch, confirmed the JSON matches the constructed source record, and confirmed an altered evidence rendering is detected. The report now explicitly limits the claim to required presence and canonical rendering, not arbitrary semantic equivalence.

recommended_clarifications: Make the C02 demand and starting-backlog assumption explicit.
Use mechanism-family coverage instead of top-level candidate counts when comparing open-ended creativity.
Treat F01 factorial oracle as a justified next-action judgment, not a proof of unique causal optimality.
unresolved_limitations: One native output per primary arm and one per factorial cell. Authored cases and explicit action menus do not estimate population-level method effects or establish method equivalence.

The primary prompts all require constraint checking and the same measurement rule; capability_first explicitly permits changing approach when evidence requires it. The contrast is instruction emphasis, not an uncorrected tool-only policy.
O01 and O02 contain proposed mechanisms and tests, not observed intervention outcomes. No real operational benefit, creativity advantage, or unique new mechanism family was demonstrated.

The factorial evidence condition changes supplied observations. Correct uncertainty handling remains successful in capability-only cells; 0 versus 3 targeted actions is not 0 versus 3 correct decisions.

F01 and F02 capability-only case texts are identical except for identifiers. F04 remains nondiscriminating in the causal condition and is a useful uncertainty control, not a fourth evidence-enabled intervention.

The factorial structured process is instructed internally; final outputs do not establish compliance with unobserved reasoning steps. Runtime, model identity/configuration, random seeds, latency, input token exposure, and actual isolation were not independently verified within this file scope.

The factorial oracle encodes authored appropriate-next-action judgments. F01 authority concentration justifies a bounded delegation attempt but does not quantify a bottleneck or prove delegation uniquely optimal; both causal-cell outputs preserve this limit.
Word counts describe JSON artifact burden, not total generation cost, human effort, runtime, or intervention efficacy. Markdown companion outputs were outside the authorized review set.
The causal capacity grid stipulates the causal relationship and fixed arrival rate. It illustrates consequences of that model; it does not discover or validate a causal model of a real organization.

The source dispatch was not independently inspected; its reported field list was used to reproduce the checklist trials. The two emitted S10 files were later directly inspected and passed required-field presence and canonical literal-rendering comparison. Production consumers, higher-level gates, arbitrary paraphrases, list-boundary preservation and general semantic correctness remain outside this test.

C02 distinguishes service capacity 9 from demand-limited completions 8. The evaluator adds an arrivals cap to the stated stage-capacity rule; document the no-starting-backlog assumption before using 8 as an absolute throughput claim. This does not change the best action.

Primary and factorial scorers check selected IDs and presence of explanation fields, not the truth of prose or open-case mechanisms. This review manually checked those claims; errors=[] alone does not provide that assurance.
verification_method: Read all scoped JSON, prompts and Python. Independently derive the twelve-action oracle and classical truth table; recompute capacity grid and parity trial mismatches in memory; recalculate factorial expectations, case-file differences and word counts; verify reported source/output hashes. Imported only evaluate.py with bytecode disabled, and never invoked source writers. After parent repairs, re-read the two modified scripts/results, independently recomputed capacity rows, extracted only the repaired compare function for missing-field probes, directly read the two authorized emitted S10 files, checked all six fields and literal rendering, and tested changed rendering. Source writers were not invoked by this reviewer.
